notes:
The watch log was drowning. protel restates every label in an invoice dialog on each repaint — three or more lines a second while you work — so "what protel opened tonight" was thousands of lines of "Amount:" and "Cancel", and the whole shift's budget was spent in about twenty minutes. Only real windows are logged now: protel's reports and its dialogs. The test never touches what gets read.

DEBUG says which helper is actually running. That number has been collected since 1.17.11 and shown to nobody, and its absence is why a feed that would not start took three releases to find.

It also stops telling you the helper is not running when it is. "Nothing is bound yet" was printed over a helper RecCheck had just started.

And the Tax Check line now says which lists the tool is holding, with the date and time each was taken — so opening a list it already has shows you it is there, instead of showing an unrelated one.
